generalization.definition: cohens_d_gap = (train_mean - val_mean) / pooled_std across the per-sample student metrics of the two splits; parameters = Wt.size + Wv.size.  train_group_targets is the number of (record, group) teacher targets, which are correlated within an image and within a prompt and are NOT independent samples; parameters_per_group_target is reported for completeness only.

notes.donor_scope: all donor maps are strictly split-local (no train/test donor in val)
notes.engineering_gate_caveat: the 0.5 prompt/image ratio floor is a pre-registered engineering heuristic, not a literature-universal threshold; it alone does not establish that the teacher signal is useless
notes.not_task_accuracy: all numbers are internal diagnostics (teacher-target correlation / ranking), never CV-Bench task accuracy
notes.test_discipline: thresholds and derangement seeds are module constants fixed before the test split was evaluated; only val decides the gate and test is reported once afterwards

score_reduction_collapse.definition: argmax token per group of the projected-prompt cosine matrix; 'single_argmax_token_fraction' is the fraction of samples whose groups all select one prompt token; 'exact_prompt_invariance_fraction' is the fraction of samples where the correct and same-image other-task student scores are exactly equal under np.array_equal; 'tolerance_invariance_fraction_1e-9' is the explicitly named tolerance-only variant

test.definition: argmax token per group of the projected-prompt cosine matrix; 'single_argmax_token_fraction' is the fraction of samples whose groups all select one prompt token; 'exact_prompt_invariance_fraction' is the fraction of samples where the correct and same-image other-task student scores are exactly equal under np.array_equal; 'tolerance_invariance_fraction_1e-9' is the explicitly named tolerance-only variant

train.definition: argmax token per group of the projected-prompt cosine matrix; 'single_argmax_token_fraction' is the fraction of samples whose groups all select one prompt token; 'exact_prompt_invariance_fraction' is the fraction of samples where the correct and same-image other-task student scores are exactly equal under np.array_equal; 'tolerance_invariance_fraction_1e-9' is the explicitly named tolerance-only variant

val.definition: argmax token per group of the projected-prompt cosine matrix; 'single_argmax_token_fraction' is the fraction of samples whose groups all select one prompt token; 'exact_prompt_invariance_fraction' is the fraction of samples where the correct and same-image other-task student scores are exactly equal under np.array_equal; 'tolerance_invariance_fraction_1e-9' is the explicitly named tolerance-only variant

projection.score_reduction_collapse_scope: split-local; the primary entry is the val split and every per-split value is computed only from that split's samples

thresholds.DATA_OR_SCHEMA_INVALID: any integrity check fails: sample/image counts, same-image group_mean bytes, teacher_soft sums, projection shapes/finiteness or index hash
thresholds.GENERALIZATION_OVERFIT: best val epoch == 0 (val never improved after initialisation) AND the train listwise KL strictly decreased over the run; the normalised train-val gap is reported alongside
thresholds.STUDENT_PROMPT_COLLAPSE: on val, none of the primary image-clustered paired deltas (correct - same-image other task, correct - split-local cross-image shuffled) is a present signal on spearman or ndcg_full under signal_present_rule
thresholds.TEACHER_PROMPT_SIGNAL_WEAK: the bootstrap 95% CI upper bound of the teacher prompt/image ranking-change ratio (same-image across-prompt / cross-image same-G donor, Spearman-distance based) is below prompt_signal_ratio_floor
thresholds.cross_image_donor: fixed-seed deterministic derangement on images (bijective, no self-pair); student same task, teacher same G and same task, prompt control cross-task
thresholds.donor_scope: strictly split-local; val never reads test/train samples
thresholds.independent_unit_student_paired_delta: image: the grounding and pointing deltas of one image are averaged before the bootstrap and the sign-flip permutation; the CSV stays per-sample and the JSON reports sample_count and independent_image_units
thresholds.prompt_signal_ratio_floor_caveat: 0.5 is a pre-registered engineering gate / heuristic criterion fixed before the test split was read, not a literature-universal threshold. It alone does not establish that the teacher signal is useless.
thresholds.signal_present_rule: signal is present iff paired 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 AND |Cohen's dz| >= effect_size_floor AND two-sided sign-flip permutation p < alpha; otherwise the signal is treated as absent

scope: prompt identifiability / degeneration diagnostic v2; diagnosis only, no training, no tuning, no model load, CPU only

prompt_embedding.definition: cosine of the mean over prompt tokens of the float16 raw token embeddings; same-image pair = grounding vs pointing of one image; cross-image = split-local fixed-seed deranged donor image, cross-task

paired_same_minus_cross.definition: per image: same_image_cosine(g_i, p_i) - cross_image_cross_task_cosine, where the cross term averages (g_i vs p_j) and (p_i vs g_j) for the deranged donor image j; never same_i minus a global mean

reduction_collapse.definition: argmax token per group of the projected-prompt cosine matrix; 'single_argmax_token_fraction' is the fraction of samples whose groups all select one prompt token; 'exact_prompt_invariance_fraction' is the fraction of samples where the correct and same-image other-task student scores are exactly equal under np.array_equal; 'tolerance_invariance_fraction_1e-9' is the explicitly named tolerance-only variant

ndcg_full.definition: image-clustered mean of (student_correct_ndcg_full - student_cross_ndcg_full) over the same-image grounding/pointing samples

pearson.definition: image-clustered mean of (student_correct_pearson - student_cross_pearson) over the same-image grounding/pointing samples

spearman.definition: image-clustered mean of (student_correct_spearman - student_cross_spearman) over the same-image grounding/pointing samples

ndcg_full.definition: image-clustered mean of (student_correct_ndcg_full - student_same_ndcg_full) over the same-image grounding/pointing samples

pearson.definition: image-clustered mean of (student_correct_pearson - student_same_pearson) over the same-image grounding/pointing samples

spearman.definition: image-clustered mean of (student_correct_spearman - student_same_spearman) over the same-image grounding/pointing samples

variance.formula: V_image = between-image variance of the per-image mean; V_prompt = within-image across-prompt variance of the per-prompt mean; V_group = within-prompt across-group variance; prompt_signal_ratio = V_prompt / V_image
